user.title: Configure OpenTherm PI Climate
user.description: Connect an OpenTherm USB gateway and select the room temperature sensor.

data.name: Name
data.restore_state: Restore saved target, mode and integral
data.frost_override_off: Allow frost protection in Off mode
data.sensor_failure_action: Action when the room sensor fails in Heat mode
data.dtr_on_open: DTR when opening the serial port
data.dtr_on_close: DTR when closing the serial port
data.rts_on_open: RTS when opening the serial port
data.rts_on_close: RTS when closing the serial port

data_description.update_interval: PI integral accumulation remains per minute regardless of this interval. Target and mode changes also request an update.
data_description.command_attempts: Total attempts, including the first attempt.
data_description.off_water_temperature: The supported firmware treats commands below 41 as heating off and uses an internal 39 °C target.
data_description.water_temperature_step: The gateway accepts only integers. Setpoints are rounded to multiples of this step, then clamped to the water limits.
data_description.hvac_modes: Select one or both firmware-supported modes. The initial mode must be selected here.
data_description.restore_state: When enabled, saved state takes precedence over initial values. Disable to use the initial target, mode and integral after restart or options reload.
data_description.frost_temperature: Threshold in °C for the selected frost-protection temperature source.
data_description.frost_target: Leave empty to follow the minimum heating water temperature. Must be within the configured water limits.
data_description.frost_override_off: When enabled, frost protection can request heating while the thermostat is Off.
data_description.sensor_failure_action: Hold keeps the last calculated water command; after startup it holds Off until an output is calculated. Frost protection can override any failure action.

error.invalid_water_range: Minimum water temperature must not exceed maximum water temperature.
error.invalid_failsafe: The failsafe target must be within the minimum and maximum water temperatures.
error.invalid_integral_range: Integral minimum must not exceed integral maximum.
error.invalid_number: Enter a finite number within the allowed range; gateway values must be whole numbers.
error.must_be_positive: Enter a value greater than zero.
error.invalid_frost_target: The frost target must be within the minimum and maximum water temperatures.
error.invalid_initial_integral: The initial integral must be within the integral limits.
error.invalid_target_range: The minimum room target must be lower than the maximum room target.
error.invalid_initial_target: The initial room target must be within the room target limits.
error.invalid_target_step: The room target step must not exceed the room target range.
error.invalid_choice: Select at least one supported option.
error.invalid_initial_mode: The initial mode must be one of the available operating modes.

abort.already_configured: This serial device is already configured.
